title: Excellent Cultural Experience!
text: I completed a Real Alcázar and Seville Cathedral tour with Adriana from Crown Tours and had a fantastic experience. Adriana was incredibly knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and passionate about history. She did an excellent job explaining the history of the Catholic Monarchs' takeover of the Alcázar while highlighting the preservation of its Moorish architectural influence. She also shared excellent food recommendations and local attractions, including Casa de Pilatos, and suggested trying Tinto de Verano.
